messages.subject: geom_bar + stat_summary + facet + show values
parts:
Hello group-members!

I want to compare 10 means of different groups in one output. I
realised it with a combination of stat_summary() and facet_wrap
without big problems:

p <- qplot("Means", value, data=dataset, geom="bar", stat="summary",
fun.y = "mean") + facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 5)

But now I wanted to add the values of the 10 different means on top of
the bars.

q <- qplot("Means", value, data=dataset, geom=c("bar", "text"),
stat="summary", fun.y = "mean", label="?") + facet_wrap(~ variable,
ncol = 5)

On top of every bar you see the ? but I to put the values of the means
there. Has anyone a hint for me, how to realise this?

I tried the following ways without success:

r1 <- qplot("Means", value, data=dataset, geom=c("bar", "text"),
stat="summary", fun.y = "mean", label=c
("5","65","39","4","1","0","1","36","42","3")) + facet_wrap(~
variable, ncol = 5)
result: error = "geom_text requires the following missing aesthetics:
label")

r2 <- qplot("Means", value, data=dataset, geom=c("bar", "text"),
stat="summary", fun.y = "mean", label=mean(value)) + facet_wrap(~
variable, ncol = 5)
result: the overall mean of value is set on every bar but not the one
of the 10 groups

How do I set the label that it works?


Torsten Stollen

this works, but I guess it's not the most elegant solution:

dataset = data.frame(value=rnorm(300), variable=c("one","two","three"))

stat="summary", fun.y = "mean", label=rep(tapply(dataset$value,
dataset$variable, mean),100)) + facet_wrap(~variable)

I think this writes each mean value a 100 times in every boxplot.

messages.subject: Re: geom_bar + stat_summary + facet + show values
parts:
I guess you could do it this way: create a new data.frame with only
the mean values and add a new layer to the plot,

library(ggplot2)
dataset = data.frame(value=100*rnorm(30), variable=c("one","two","three"))

datameans = ddply(dataset,.(variable), summarize, mean=round(mean(value)))

fun.y = "mean") + facet_wrap(~ variable,scales="free")

p + geom_text(data=datameans, aes(y=mean, label=mean))

but one summary calculation seems redundant.

HTH,

baptiste
